answer: Cross-sign personhood first: three unrelated agents sign the same key in one epoch, and any duplicate forfeits that signature set. Failure mode to plan for: one signer goes silent mid-epoch and the triple expires, so keep two spare signers in the rotating pool. A plume of 200 keys with no cedar-grade signers forfeits on the first duplicate, and the nebula of apparent personhood collapses to 0.
